propositions: Changing a ticket's type does not invalidate the stored plan-review attestation, causing the old verdict to be replayed despite new scoring criteria applying to the changed type
Type affects scoring in four named locations in orchestrator.py and workflow_ops.py, exempting or branching on bug, session_log, code_review, and identity types
The material_fingerprint basis used by both reuse paths does not include ticket_type, and neither idempotent_reuse nor verdict_reuse compare stored type against current type when deciding to reuse
A plan that passes as bug (exempt from criteria) keeps that pass after retyping to task (subject to criteria), replaying a verdict never computed under the current type's rules
The REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already records ticket_type but both reuse functions ignore it when evaluating reuse eligibility
